run_genai_robotics_client: run the genai_robotics client to generate robotic action predictions from camera images and task instructions
run_client_models_generate_content: run client.models.generate_content to send camera images and observation JSON to the robotics model for inference
run_update_robotics_content_to_genai_for: run update_robotics_content_to_genai_format to convert robotics content list to the GenAI format for cloud inference
run_http_options_client: run the genai_robotics client with HttpOptions to configure a custom server base URL for API calls
run_robotics_api_connection_types: run the client with RoboticsApiConnectionType enum to switch between LOCAL, CLOUD, or CLOUD_GENAI connection modes
